review:
The game where Moving Cash Out made its debut. On 24 reels, it keeps the Coins formula of Cash Infinity and Hold the Jackpot, but adds a feature that moves as you spin and gets more exciting as it goes.

Hold the Jackpot gives you 24 reels to fill and a 1,200x Grand. Cash Infinity helps you get to the bonus, and Chance Level lets you raise your bet for better odds. High volatility, 96.15% RTP. If you've played Cash Grotto, you'll recognise Moving Cash Out; this is where it started.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
